property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and matching v arrays, transfer returns true and either all external calls succeeded (no revert) or the call reverted; if it returns true then it must not have reverted during its internal calls.
If C.transfer does not revert (call succeeds), it returns true.
If transfer is called with non-empty _tos and matching lengths, then it either reverts or returns true (i.e., it cannot return false).
For any non-empty _tos with matching lengths, C.transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false).
